camel_example: aliyun iot UpdateConsumerGroup --region cn-hangzhou --NewGroupName '消费组2' --GroupId nJRaJPn5U1JITGf000000
description_en: Modifies the name of a consumer group when you use AMQP server-side subscription
description_zh: 使用AMQP服务端订阅时，可以调用该接口修改消费组名称
kebab_example: aliyun iot update-consumer-group --new-group-name '消费组2' --group-id nJRaJPn5U1JITGf000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateConsumerGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the consumer group. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length. Each Chinese character is counted as two characters
parameters.help_zh: 消费组的新名称。支持中文汉字、英文字母、数字和下划线（_），长度为4~30个字符，一个汉字计为两个字符
parameters.name: new_group_name

parameters.help_en: The consumer group ID. After you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170388.html to create a consumer group, the consumer group ID is returned. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170419.html to query the consumer group ID by consumer group name
parameters.help_zh: 消费组ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170388.html创建消费组成功后，会返回消费组ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170419.html按消费组名称查询消费组ID
parameters.name: group_id
